text: "fix this" (on the pricing review's "Realtime fan-out" item: publishes and deliveries share one meter, so a broadcast to 1,000 listeners pays for 1,000 deliveries that cost us nothing) — Realtime messages bill publishes only (messages_in); deliveries to sockets (messages_out) are free. Price stays $0.62 per million messages, connection-minutes unchanged. Replaces the "publishes in + frames delivered out" counting in r-p3dsj9znvtnyhphr.
